bibliographic.title: FINAL CUT
bibliographic.author: Johnny Rewind
bibliographic.description:
You are Vera Kessler, a cursed 1970s grindhouse actress, trapped on an abandoned studio lot that will not let her leave. Every wing of the lot is a different horror genre, and every one of them has become real: slasher, cult, mad science, creature feature, the dead. Seven wings, seven genres, one mask.

FINAL CUT is a text-driven horror game built on dread, not combat. Your choices cost something. Wounds and corruption carry from wing to wing, and the lot remembers what you did.

Length: about 1.5 hours.

Content note: sustained psychological horror, written descriptions of violence, and a captivity and torture theme in the protagonist's backstory that implies, but does not depict, sexual assault. No nudity, no sexual content.

A commercial release for Windows on Steam, $7.99, launching December 7, 2026.

AI disclosure (per the Steam page): the background images were generated with AI tools, and the story text was drafted with AI tools under the author's direction. Full details are on the Steam page.
